cues: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds, and it is set by frequency.
The higher the frequency, the higher the pitch.
A normal ear hears from about twenty hertz to twenty thousand hertz.
Below that is infrasonic, like earthquake rumbles and elephant calls.
Above it is ultrasonic, used by bats and dolphins, and in medical scanning.
